text:
In HL7 version 2.3.1, **MSH-21 does not exist as a defined field**.

The MSH (Message Header) segment in HL7 v2.3.1 only extends through **MSH-20 (Alternate Character Handling Scheme)**.

The **MSH-21 field** was introduced later, in **HL7 version 2.4**, where it was defined as **"Conformance Statement ID."** This was subsequently changed/repurposed in **HL7 version 2.5** to **"Message Profile Identifier,"** which contains an EI (Entity Identifier) data type used to reference a specific conformance profile or message profile that the message claims to conform to.

So to summarize:
- **v2.3.1:** MSH-21 is not defined (MSH ends at field 20)
- **v2.4:** MSH-21 = Conformance Statement ID
- **v2.5 and later:** MSH-21 = Message Profile Identifier

If you're working with a v2.3.1 interface and seeing data in an MSH-21 position, it may be a custom/local (Z-type) extension rather than a standard field.
